tableDescription: Records each line item sold at a physical cafe outlet, capturing product, quantity, price, payment method, and sales channel per POS transaction.

columnDescriptions.hash_key: Internal deduplication key generated at ingestion; exclude from all business reporting.
columnDescriptions.bill_no: POS receipt number; combine with store_location to uniquely identify a transaction.
columnDescriptions.txn_datetime: Exact date and time the sale was rung up at the till.
columnDescriptions.store_location: Name or code of the cafe outlet where the sale occurred.
columnDescriptions.item_name: Raw menu item name as captured directly from the POS system.
columnDescriptions.qty: Number of units of this item purchased on this bill line.
columnDescriptions.rate: Unit selling price charged for this item, in INR.
columnDescriptions.amount: Total line revenue in INR (qty × rate), before any bill-level discounts.
columnDescriptions.payment_mode: Customer's chosen payment method — cash, card, UPI, or wallet.
columnDescriptions.channel_code: Short sales-channel code; join dim_channels for full name, group, and settlement currency.
columnDescriptions.insert_timestamp: UTC pipeline load time into the silver layer; not a business event.
columnDescriptions.modified_timestamp: UTC time the ingestion pipeline last updated this row; not a business event.
columnDescriptions.source_name: Originating upstream system or file name; used for data lineage only.
columnDescriptions.is_deleted: Soft-delete flag; always exclude TRUE rows from business reporting.
columnDescriptions.order_date_key: Transaction calendar date; use this to join dim_date for period-level reporting.
columnDescriptions.product_id: Canonical SKU mapped from the till item name; joins to item_master.

tableDescription: Silver-layer fact table storing retail invoice line items, one row per product sold, across multiple sales channels.

columnDescriptions.hash_key: Pipeline-generated deduplication key; not a business attribute and should be excluded from reporting.
columnDescriptions.invoice_no: Retail invoice identifier; 'C' prefix signals cancellation; one invoice spans multiple product lines.
columnDescriptions.stock_code: Internal product identifier assigned by the legacy retail system.
columnDescriptions.description: Free-text product name captured at the point of sale from the legacy system.
columnDescriptions.quantity: Units sold on this line; negative values represent cancellations or credit adjustments.
columnDescriptions.invoice_date: Business timestamp when the invoice line was recorded in the legacy system.
columnDescriptions.unit_price: Price per unit charged on this line in the legacy transaction currency.
columnDescriptions.customer_id: Legacy customer identifier; blank for guest or otherwise unidentified transactions.
columnDescriptions.country: Destination country for the order as recorded at point of sale.
columnDescriptions.is_cancelled: TRUE for cancellation or credit lines; mirrors the 'C'-prefixed invoice numbers.
columnDescriptions.line_amount: Total value for this line: quantity multiplied by unit price.
columnDescriptions.channel_code: Sales channel short code (e.g., D2C, OFFLINE); joins to dim_channels for full details.
columnDescriptions.insert_timestamp: UTC pipeline load time into the silver layer; not a business event timestamp.
columnDescriptions.modified_timestamp: UTC timestamp of the last pipeline update; not a business event timestamp.
columnDescriptions.source_name: Upstream source system or file name; used for lineage and troubleshooting only.
columnDescriptions.is_deleted: Soft-delete flag set by the pipeline; exclude TRUE rows from business reporting.

tableDescription: Silver-layer conformed customer master storing the latest profile, contact details, location, acquisition channel, and loyalty tier for every known customer.

columnDescriptions.hash_key: Internal pipeline fingerprint for deduplication and change detection; not meaningful for business use.
columnDescriptions.customer_master_id: Cross-channel unique identifier linking this customer to all fact tables and the gold dimension.
columnDescriptions.customer_name: Full name as captured on the customer's most recent order.
columnDescriptions.email: Primary contact and identity-matching key used to unify the customer across channels.
columnDescriptions.phone: Secondary contact and identity-matching key used to resolve the customer across channels.
columnDescriptions.city: City from the customer's most recently known address.
columnDescriptions.state: State or region from the customer's most recently known address.
columnDescriptions.country: Country from the customer's most recently known address.
columnDescriptions.signup_date: Date the customer's account was first created across any channel.
columnDescriptions.acquisition_channel: Sales channel where the customer placed their very first order.
columnDescriptions.loyalty_tier: Current membership tier (e.g., Bronze, Silver, Gold) assigned by the loyalty program.
columnDescriptions.rn: Recency rank per customer; value of 1 marks the current, deduplicated record.
columnDescriptions.insert_timestamp: Pipeline load time when the record first entered the silver layer.
columnDescriptions.modified_timestamp: Pipeline processing time of the most recent update to this record.
columnDescriptions.source_name: Upstream system or file this record was ingested from; used for lineage only.
columnDescriptions.is_deleted: TRUE indicates the source record was removed upstream; exclude from business reporting.

tableDescription: Line-item-level direct-to-consumer Shopify orders capturing product, pricing, discounts, shipping, and customer details for revenue analysis.

columnDescriptions.hash_key: Internal deduplication key generated during ingestion; not meaningful for business reporting.
columnDescriptions.order_name: Shopify-assigned order identifier (e.g. #1001); shared across all line items of the same order.
columnDescriptions.created_at: Exact date and time the customer placed the order on the storefront.
columnDescriptions.customer_email: Email used at checkout; links this order to the customer master.
columnDescriptions.customer_name: Full name entered by the customer during checkout.
columnDescriptions.billing_city: City from the billing address provided at checkout.
columnDescriptions.line_item_title: Storefront product name for this specific order line.
columnDescriptions.line_item_qty: Number of units of the product purchased on this line.
columnDescriptions.line_item_price: Per-unit selling price in INR at time of order, before discounts.
columnDescriptions.discount_code: Promotional or coupon code the customer applied at checkout.
columnDescriptions.shipping_amount: Shipping fee in INR charged on the order; may repeat per line.
columnDescriptions.line_total: Revenue collected for this line in INR, after discounts.
columnDescriptions.channel_code: Identifies the sales channel (e.g. D2C, CAFE); joins to dim_channels.
columnDescriptions.insert_timestamp: Pipeline load time into the silver layer; not a business event.
columnDescriptions.modified_timestamp: Last pipeline update time; reflects ingestion processing, not business activity.
columnDescriptions.source_name: Upstream system or file this record came from; used for lineage only.
columnDescriptions.is_deleted: Marks records removed upstream; exclude TRUE rows from business reporting.
columnDescriptions.order_date_key: Transaction date in YYYY-MM-DD; use to join dim_date for period reporting.
columnDescriptions.product_id: SKU identifier linking to item_master for product name, category, and brand.

tableDescription: Conformed customer dimension with one current record per customer, covering identity, location, acquisition channel, and loyalty tier.

columnDescriptions.hash_key: Internal pipeline identifier for deduplication and change-detection; exclude from business reporting.
columnDescriptions.customer_master_id: Unique enterprise-wide identifier linking this customer across all source systems.
columnDescriptions.customer_name: Full name as recorded on the customer's most recent order.
columnDescriptions.email: Primary contact address and identity-matching key used during customer resolution.
columnDescriptions.phone: Secondary contact number and identity-matching key used during customer resolution.
columnDescriptions.city: City from the customer's most recently known address.
columnDescriptions.state: State or region from the customer's most recently known address.
columnDescriptions.country: Country from the customer's most recently known address.
columnDescriptions.signup_date: Date the customer first created an account in any channel.
columnDescriptions.acquisition_channel: Sales or marketing channel through which the customer was originally acquired.
columnDescriptions.loyalty_tier: Current membership tier level assigned to the customer (e.g., Bronze, Platinum).
columnDescriptions.rn: Pipeline row number; value of 1 identifies the current, latest record version.
columnDescriptions.insert_timestamp: UTC pipeline load time when the record first entered the silver layer; not a business event.
columnDescriptions.modified_timestamp: UTC pipeline processing time of the most recent update; not a business event.
columnDescriptions.source_name: Upstream system or file name; supports data lineage and troubleshooting only.
columnDescriptions.is_deleted: Soft-delete flag; rows marked TRUE were removed upstream and must be excluded from reporting.

tableDescription: Dimension table storing direct-to-consumer Shopify orders, capturing order identity, placement date, and customer contact details.

columnDescriptions.order_name: Shopify-generated order identifier; serves as the unique key for each D2C transaction.
columnDescriptions.order_date_key: Calendar date the order was placed; primary key for time-based reporting joins.
columnDescriptions.customer_email: Email address provided by the customer at purchase; used for customer identification.

tableDescription: Date dimension providing calendar attributes for every date, enabling time-based filtering, grouping, and joining across all fact tables.

columnDescriptions.date_key: Primary grain and join key linking all fact table date foreign keys.
columnDescriptions.cal_year: Four-digit calendar year for annual reporting and filtering.
columnDescriptions.cal_month: Numeric month (1–12) for monthly filtering and aggregation.
columnDescriptions.year_month: Sortable YYYY-MM string enabling consistent month-over-month trend grouping.
columnDescriptions.month_name: Human-readable month label for display in reports and dashboards.
columnDescriptions.cal_quarter: Quarter number (1–4) supporting quarterly performance rollups and comparisons.
columnDescriptions.day_of_week: Numeric day-of-week identifier for weekly pattern and cycle analysis.
columnDescriptions.is_weekend: Flags Saturday and Sunday dates for weekday versus weekend segmentation.

tableDescription: Stores employee records including identity, job role, store assignment, sales channel, hire date, and employment status.

columnDescriptions.hash_key: Internal deduplication key; not meaningful for business reporting.
columnDescriptions.employee_id: Unique identifier for each employee across the organization.
columnDescriptions.employee_name: Full legal or display name of the employee.
columnDescriptions.role: Job title or function held by the employee (e.g., Barista, Store Manager).
columnDescriptions.channel_code: Sales or operational channel the employee is staffed under.
columnDescriptions.store_id: Physical store or outlet where the employee is assigned.
columnDescriptions.hire_date: Date the employee officially joined the company.
columnDescriptions.employment_status: Current workforce standing: Active, On Leave, Resigned, or Terminated.
columnDescriptions.rn: Ingestion pipeline row number; value of 1 indicates the latest record version.
columnDescriptions.insert_timestamp: Pipeline load time when the record first entered the silver layer.
columnDescriptions.modified_timestamp: Pipeline time of the most recent record update; not a business event.
columnDescriptions.source_name: Upstream source system or file; used for lineage, not business analysis.
columnDescriptions.is_deleted: Soft-delete flag; TRUE means the record was removed upstream and should be excluded.

tableDescription: Records cross-border export orders including product, pricing, shipping costs, customs duties, destination country, and current shipment status per line item.

columnDescriptions.hash_key: Internal deduplication key generated at ingestion; not a business attribute, exclude from reporting.
columnDescriptions.order_ref: Unique business reference number assigned to each international export order.
columnDescriptions.order_date: Date the customer placed the order.
columnDescriptions.dest_country: Country to which the order was shipped.
columnDescriptions.customer_name: Full name of the purchasing customer as entered at checkout.
columnDescriptions.product_desc: Free-text product description captured from the international order source system.
columnDescriptions.product_ref_code: Source system's product code before mapping to the canonical product identifier.
columnDescriptions.qty: Number of product units included in this order line.
columnDescriptions.unit_price_usd: Price charged per unit on this line, denominated in USD.
columnDescriptions.shipping_cost_usd: Total shipping fee charged on this order, in USD.
columnDescriptions.customs_duty_usd: Import/customs duty levied on this order, in USD.
columnDescriptions.shipment_status: Current fulfillment stage of the order (e.g., Delivered, In Transit, Customs Hold).
columnDescriptions.channel_code: Sales channel identifier; join to dim_channels for full name and settlement currency.
columnDescriptions.insert_timestamp: Pipeline load time when the record entered the silver layer; not a business event.
columnDescriptions.modified_timestamp: Pipeline processing time of the last ingestion update; not a business event.
columnDescriptions.source_name: Upstream system or file the record was ingested from; used for lineage only.
columnDescriptions.is_deleted: Soft-delete flag; exclude rows marked TRUE from all business reporting.
columnDescriptions.order_date_key: Canonical order date for joining to dim_date for period-based reporting.
columnDescriptions.product_id: Canonical SKU; join to item_master for product name, category, and brand.

tableDescription: Daily point-in-time stock level snapshots per product, tracking units on hand across all locations for inventory visibility.

columnDescriptions.hash_key: Internal deduplication key; not for business reporting or analysis.
columnDescriptions.product_id: Unique product/SKU identifier linking to the item master catalog.
columnDescriptions.snapshot_date: The calendar date when stock levels were recorded.
columnDescriptions.units_on_hand: Total stock units available across all locations on the snapshot date.
columnDescriptions.rn: Row number where 1 = most recent record; filters out historical duplicates.
columnDescriptions.insert_timestamp: Pipeline load time when the record entered the silver layer; not a business event.
columnDescriptions.modified_timestamp: Pipeline processing time of the last record update; not a business event.
columnDescriptions.source_name: Upstream system or file that provided this record; used for lineage only.
columnDescriptions.is_deleted: Marks records removed upstream; TRUE rows should be excluded from reporting.

tableDescription: Central product catalog storing SKU-level attributes including name, category, brand, unit of measure, and lifecycle status for all channels.

columnDescriptions.hash_key: Internal deduplication key generated at ingestion; not meaningful for business reporting or analysis.
columnDescriptions.product_id: Cross-channel canonical SKU identifier used after source code mapping.
columnDescriptions.product_name: Official display name shown to customers and used across channels.
columnDescriptions.category: Broad grouping of similar products, such as Beverages or Apparel.
columnDescriptions.brand: Commercial brand under which the product is marketed and sold.
columnDescriptions.uom: Selling and stocking unit, such as each, kilogram, or box.
columnDescriptions.status: Indicates whether the product is active, discontinued, or another lifecycle stage.
columnDescriptions.insert_timestamp: Pipeline load time when the record first entered the silver layer.
columnDescriptions.modified_timestamp: Pipeline processing time of the most recent update to this record.
columnDescriptions.source_name: Identifies the upstream system or file for lineage and troubleshooting only.
columnDescriptions.is_deleted: Soft-delete flag; TRUE means the source removed this product—exclude from reporting.

tableDescription: Line-level sales transactions recorded at physical retail store tills, capturing product, pricing, discount, and payment details per invoice line.

columnDescriptions.hash_key: Pipeline-generated deduplication key; not a business attribute, exclude from reporting.
columnDescriptions.invoice_no: Unique bill number issued by the POS system at the store till.
columnDescriptions.txn_date: Calendar date the in-store sale took place.
columnDescriptions.store_code: Identifier for the retail store where the transaction occurred.
columnDescriptions.city: City where the selling store is located.
columnDescriptions.item_name: Raw product name as captured by the POS system at the till.
columnDescriptions.item_code: POS-native item identifier before mapping to the canonical product ID.
columnDescriptions.qty: Number of units of this product sold on the invoice line.
columnDescriptions.mrp: Published list price of the item at the time of sale.
columnDescriptions.discount_pct: Percentage discount applied to reduce MRP on this line item.
columnDescriptions.net_amount: Amount charged to the customer after discount, in Indian Rupees.
columnDescriptions.payment_type: Customer's payment method, such as cash, card, or UPI.
columnDescriptions.channel_code: Short code for the sales channel; join dim_channels for full details.
columnDescriptions.insert_timestamp: Pipeline load time when the record first entered the silver layer.
columnDescriptions.modified_timestamp: Pipeline processing time when the record was last updated by ingestion.
columnDescriptions.source_name: Upstream source system or file name; used for lineage and troubleshooting only.
columnDescriptions.is_deleted: Soft-delete flag; exclude rows marked TRUE from all business reporting.
columnDescriptions.order_date_key: Transaction date for joining to dim_date for time-based reporting.
columnDescriptions.product_id: Canonical SKU identifier; joins to item_master for product attributes.

tableDescription: Records daily marketing expenditure, impressions, and clicks per promotion and sales channel, enabling campaign spend performance analysis.

columnDescriptions.hash_key: Internal deduplication key; not for reporting or business use.
columnDescriptions.spend_id: Unique business identifier for a single marketing spend transaction.
columnDescriptions.promo_id: Links this spend to a specific promotion or campaign.
columnDescriptions.channel_code: Identifies the sales channel targeted, e.g., PLATFORM, OFFLINE, D2C, CAFE.
columnDescriptions.spend_date: Calendar date on which the marketing expenditure was incurred.
columnDescriptions.spend_amount_inr: Total marketing money spent in Indian Rupees for this record.
columnDescriptions.impressions: Total ad views delivered for this promotion and channel on the date.
columnDescriptions.clicks: Total user ad clicks for this promotion and channel on the date.
columnDescriptions.rn: Value of 1 marks the current record among historical duplicates.
columnDescriptions.insert_timestamp: UTC time when the record first loaded into the silver layer.
columnDescriptions.modified_timestamp: UTC time of the most recent pipeline update to this record.
columnDescriptions.source_name: Upstream system or file this record originated from; for lineage only.
columnDescriptions.is_deleted: TRUE when the source record was removed; exclude from business reporting.

tableDescription: Stores time-versioned Maximum Retail Price records per product, enabling point-in-time price lookups across validity windows.

columnDescriptions.hash_key: Internal deduplication key; not a business attribute, exclude from reporting.
columnDescriptions.product_id: Links each price record to a specific product or SKU.
columnDescriptions.mrp: Official list price before discounts, valid during the defined date window.
columnDescriptions.effective_from: Inclusive start date of this MRP's validity period.
columnDescriptions.effective_to: End date of MRP validity; NULL or far-future date indicates the current active price.
columnDescriptions.currency: Currency in which the MRP value is expressed.
columnDescriptions.insert_timestamp: Pipeline load time when the record first entered the silver layer.
columnDescriptions.modified_timestamp: Pipeline processing time of the most recent update to this record.
columnDescriptions.source_name: Upstream system or file origin; used for lineage and troubleshooting only.
columnDescriptions.is_deleted: Marks records removed upstream; exclude TRUE rows from business reporting.

tableDescription: Tracks individual shipments from dispatch to delivery, linking orders across sales channels to couriers and current delivery status.

columnDescriptions.hash_key: Internal deduplication key; not a business attribute, exclude from reporting.
columnDescriptions.shipment_id: Unique business identifier for each shipment.
columnDescriptions.channel_code: Sales channel through which the shipped order was originally placed.
columnDescriptions.order_ref: Cross-channel reference linking this shipment to its originating order.
columnDescriptions.courier_name: Logistics partner responsible for physically carrying and delivering the shipment.
columnDescriptions.dispatch_date: Date the shipment physically left the warehouse or store.
columnDescriptions.delivered_date: Date the shipment reached the customer; NULL means not yet delivered.
columnDescriptions.delivery_status: Current tracking status such as In Transit, Delivered, or Lost.
columnDescriptions.rn: Row number per shipment; value of 1 indicates the latest active record.
columnDescriptions.insert_timestamp: Pipeline load timestamp when the record entered the silver layer; not a business event.
columnDescriptions.modified_timestamp: Pipeline timestamp of the most recent update; not a business event.
columnDescriptions.source_name: Upstream source system or file; for lineage and troubleshooting only.
columnDescriptions.is_deleted: Soft-delete flag; exclude rows where TRUE from all business reporting.

tableDescription: Master list of approved suppliers including their category, country, contract start date, average lead time, and current status.

columnDescriptions.hash_key: Internal deduplication key; not meaningful for business analysis or reporting.
columnDescriptions.supplier_id: Unique business identifier for each supplier.
columnDescriptions.supplier_name: Legal or trading name of the supplier company.
columnDescriptions.category: Type of goods or services the supplier provides.
columnDescriptions.country: Country where the supplier operates or is headquartered.
columnDescriptions.contract_start_date: Date the active supply agreement with this supplier commenced.
columnDescriptions.avg_lead_time_days: Average number of days from purchase order placement to delivery.
columnDescriptions.status: Indicates whether the supplier is Active, Suspended, or Terminated.
columnDescriptions.rn: Row number; value of 1 identifies the latest active record version.
columnDescriptions.insert_timestamp: Pipeline load time when the record entered the silver layer; not a business event.
columnDescriptions.modified_timestamp: Pipeline processing time of the last record update; not a business event.
columnDescriptions.source_name: Upstream system or file the record originated from; used for lineage only.
columnDescriptions.is_deleted: Flags records removed upstream; TRUE rows should be excluded from reporting.

tableDescription: Order line-level sales from third-party marketplaces, capturing product, pricing, fees, discounts, shipping destination, and fulfillment status.

columnDescriptions.hash_key: Internal deduplication key generated at ingestion. Exclude from all business reporting.
columnDescriptions.marketplace: Third-party platform where the order was placed (e.g., Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra).
columnDescriptions.order_id: Unique order identifier assigned by the marketplace.
columnDescriptions.order_date: Calendar date the customer placed the order on the marketplace.
columnDescriptions.product_title: Product name as displayed on the marketplace listing for this order line.
columnDescriptions.marketplace_sku: Platform-specific listing ID before mapping to the canonical product identifier.
columnDescriptions.units: Number of product units purchased on this order line.
columnDescriptions.unit_price: Per-unit selling price in INR, before marketplace fees or promotional discounts.
columnDescriptions.marketplace_fee: Commission charged by the marketplace on this order line, in INR.
columnDescriptions.promo_discount: Promotional discount applied to this order line by the marketplace, in INR.
columnDescriptions.ship_to_city: City the order was delivered to.
columnDescriptions.ship_to_country: Country the order was delivered to.
columnDescriptions.fulfillment_status: Current order lifecycle status (e.g., Pending, Shipped, Delivered, Cancelled, Refunded).
columnDescriptions.channel_code: Short sales-channel code; joins to dim_channels for full name, group, and settlement currency.
columnDescriptions.insert_timestamp: Pipeline load time when the record first entered the silver layer; not a business event.
columnDescriptions.modified_timestamp: Pipeline processing time of the most recent record update; not a business event.
columnDescriptions.source_name: Upstream source system or file name; used for lineage and troubleshooting only.
columnDescriptions.is_deleted: Soft-delete flag; exclude rows marked TRUE from all business reporting.
columnDescriptions.order_date_key: Join key to dim_date for calendar-based month, quarter, and year reporting.
columnDescriptions.product_id: Canonical SKU identifier; joins to item_master for product name, category, and brand.

tableDescription: Defines sellable product bundles and their component SKUs, capturing each included product and quantity per bundle unit.

columnDescriptions.hash_key: Internal deduplication key generated at ingestion; exclude from all business reporting and analysis.
columnDescriptions.bundle_id: Unique business identifier for a sellable product bundle or combo.
columnDescriptions.bundle_name: Customer-facing display name of the bundle as marketed and sold.
columnDescriptions.component_product_id: Identifies a single SKU within the bundle; links to item_master for product details.
columnDescriptions.component_qty: Number of units of this component product included in one bundle.
columnDescriptions.insert_timestamp: Pipeline load time when the record first entered the silver layer; not a business event.
columnDescriptions.modified_timestamp: Pipeline processing time of the most recent record update; not a business event time.
columnDescriptions.source_name: Upstream system or file the record originated from; used for lineage only.
columnDescriptions.is_deleted: Marks records removed upstream; exclude rows flagged TRUE from business reporting.

tableDescription: Maps each sales channel's native product codes and names to a canonical product identifier for cross-channel reconciliation.

columnDescriptions.hash_key: Pipeline-generated deduplication and change-detection key; not a business attribute.
columnDescriptions.product_id: Canonical product/SKU identifier linking this channel code to the master product catalog.
columnDescriptions.channel_code: Identifies the sales channel (e.g., OFFLINE, CAFE, D2C) to which this code mapping applies.
columnDescriptions.source_code: Native product or SKU code assigned by the upstream channel before canonical mapping.
columnDescriptions.source_product_name: Native product name used by the upstream channel before canonical mapping.
columnDescriptions.insert_timestamp: UTC pipeline load time when the record was first ingested into the silver layer.
columnDescriptions.modified_timestamp: UTC pipeline time of the most recent record update; not a business event.
columnDescriptions.source_name: Upstream system or file the record was ingested from; used for data lineage.
columnDescriptions.is_deleted: Soft-delete flag; rows marked TRUE were removed upstream and should be excluded from reporting.

tableDescription: Stores marketing promotions and discount campaigns across sales channels, including coupon codes, discount rates, and active date ranges.

columnDescriptions.hash_key: Pipeline-internal deduplication key; exclude from all business reporting and analysis.
columnDescriptions.promo_id: Primary business identifier distinguishing each individual promotion or campaign offer.
columnDescriptions.promo_code: Alphanumeric code customers apply at checkout to redeem the discount.
columnDescriptions.channel_code: Sales or distribution channel where the promotion was made available.
columnDescriptions.discount_pct: Percentage reduction in price granted to customers under this promotion.
columnDescriptions.start_date: First day customers can redeem this promotion, inclusive.
columnDescriptions.end_date: Last day customers can redeem this promotion, inclusive.
columnDescriptions.campaign_name: Broader marketing campaign grouping that this promotion belongs to.
columnDescriptions.rn: Filter to rn = 1 to retrieve only the latest record version.
columnDescriptions.insert_timestamp: Pipeline load time into the silver layer; not a business event.
columnDescriptions.modified_timestamp: Pipeline processing time of the last update; not a business event.
columnDescriptions.source_name: Upstream system or file the record originated from; for lineage only.
columnDescriptions.is_deleted: TRUE indicates the promotion was removed upstream; exclude from reporting.
